args.message: Orders with amount over 100 are 'big' and all others are 'small'. Big: 822 orders, revenue 117,689.06. Small: 4,194 orders, revenue 214,999.39. I set the class inside this query only, so the stored orders model was not changed. Any order with no amount would count as 'small'.
